request.input:
scenery, no humans, An isolated looming sealed laboratory entrance silhouette: a tall charcoal monolith with a narrow ivory vertical opening and one muted rust-red fissure at its foot, two low offset wall blocks. No creature, no magic symbols, no glowing orb.

Symbolic game layer-entry cinematic, one isolated architectural emblem in a nearly black empty field, same restrained visual series as a fractured city reflection.

Wide landscape. Architectural emblem on the right half, occupying one third of canvas width and half its height. Left forty percent quiet almost black for an existing caption. Broad simple silhouettes, enormous uninterrupted black negative space.

Matte charcoal, warm grey, ivory and extremely sparse muted rust-red. Broad opaque painted planes, selective rough edges, restrained contrast, no tiny surface details.
